text:
Maya (Mktg): Landing page is live and registration looks good. Need final social package for X + LinkedIn + 2 short RSVP nudge variants (email-style and curiosity-style). Also want a 6hr pre-webinar push on X with a different hook. Can we lock by 2PM PT?

Liam (Social): Yes. I'll schedule main posts and the 6hr nudge. Suggestion: X nudge should be ultra-short and link to quick register; LinkedIn nudge can include a 1-line customer quote.

Sam (Creative): Uploaded 3 hero crops + a 6:1 banner for email header: https://drive.redwood/assets/webinar_may. One square needs logo padding, will fix now.

Devon (Demand): For RSVP nudge variants:
- Variant A (email-style): "Seats filling — save your spot for Thu 11AM PT: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x_nudge"
- Variant B (curiosity): "We uncovered one surprise in our benchmark. Want to know what it is? Join Thu 11AM PT: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin_nudge"
I'll add short lead qualifiers for replies.

Maya (Mktg): Nice. Also layering ask: we want to seed 5 industry influencers to retweet/reshare the on-demand CTA after the live session. Liam, can you DM a list of 10 potential people to Sam for assets?

Liam (Social): I'll DM a shortlist. Quick scheduling plan I'm adding to Buffer:
```
- X main post @10:30 PT: 1-line hook + reg link + #inference
- X 6hr nudge @5:00 AM PT (same day): urgency hook + reg link
- LinkedIn main @11:00 PT: 2-bullet benefits + event tag + long reg link with utm
- LinkedIn 6hr nudge @6:00 AM PT: customer quote + CTA
```
Buffer will have UTM templates: utm_source=x, utm_campaign=may_webinar, utm_content=main|nudge.

Sam (Creative): Assets for influencers: PNG with 4:1 banner and a variant without logos for partners. Uploading now.

Devon (Demand): Reply templates for high-value engagement (short):
1) Qualification reply: "Thanks for the interest! Quick Q: How many production LLMs are you running today? Can I send a short calendar link?"
2) Technical reply: "Happy to share more — which model family or sequence lengths are you most interested in?"
Dropping calendar link in 5.

Maya (Mktg): Good. Liam, add a note to pause paid promotion if CTR > 3% organically in the first 2 hours so we can reallocate budget to retargeting. Also tag the post with the webinar event and add the influencer handles when they agree.

SDR Bot: New leads form will push to #sales-leads with tag "webinar_may" and include UTM & referrer.

Liam (Social): Scheduling set up; will share Buffer URLs once posts are queued. Also setting the 6hr nudge copy to use the alternate hero crop to avoid creative fatigue.

Sam (Creative): Done exporting the influencer-friendly banners, email header, and the alternate hero. Links: https://drive.redwood/assets/webinar_may/finals.zip

Maya (Mktg): Final checklist before lock: 1) UTM applied to all links 2) Buffer schedule confirmed 3) Reply templates in thread 4) Influencer assets uploaded 5) Boost rule defined. If all green I'll mark ready and Liam can schedule.

Liam (Social): All green from my side. Scheduling now. Will post Buffer links here when live. :rocket:
